ruleName: Do not touch or test the sand
title: What is not allowed before your bunker shot?
question: Before playing from a bunker, which of these are you not allowed to do?

choices.text: Touch the sand with your hand to see how soft it is
Make a practice swing that touches the sand
Rest your club on the sand behind your ball before hitting
Play your shot without touching the sand first
Lean on your club while standing outside the bunker

explanation: You are not allowed to test or touch the sand with your hand, touch the sand with your club during practice swings, or ground your club behind your ball before you hit.

issues: Golfer is a boy rather than the specified girl
